caption:
One lantern, then thousands. 🏮

Seedance 2.5 caught every flicker of light in this one. It feels like a real memory.
prompt:
use seedance 2.5 for this

VIDEO PROMPT — 60 seconds, 16:9 landscape. Photorealistic intimate documentary look, as if filmed handheld by a friend: 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, natural light only (dusk sky, then warm lantern glow at night), soft film grain, warm amber skin tones against deep blue twilight. Camera feel: gentle handheld sway, close and personal. Pacing: calm, a cut roughly every 2 seconds, building from one lantern to thousands.

CHARACTERS (only these two people appear up close):
- THE YOUNG WOMAN: East Asian, early 20s, fair skin, soft round face, dark brown shoulder-length hair worn loose with wispy see-through bangs, light natural makeup with rosy lips. Wears a loose cream-white linen button shirt with rolled sleeves, navy-blue wide-leg trousers and white canvas sneakers.
- THE LOCAL WOMAN: South/Southeast Asian, about 60, warm tan skin, dark hair pulled back in a low bun, kind lined face. Wears a cream top with a deep crimson-maroon patterned shawl draped over one shoulder and a small pendant necklace.
- THE LANTERN: one plain white paper sky lantern, tall rounded shape with vertical seams, a thin round bamboo ring at its open bottom held by two crossed wires, a single small flame burning only from the central wick.

LOCATION: a vast flat open grassland, short dry grass and bare earth, an empty flat horizon. Starts at dusk (pink-orange glow at the horizon, pale blue sky), becomes deep blue night by 00:14.

SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:01.8) — Low handheld tracking shot of the young woman's legs jogging across the grass in white sneakers and navy trousers, a folded white paper lantern flapping in her hand, motion blur.
SHOT 2 (00:01.8-00:04.0) — Medium-wide at dusk: the local woman (left) lifts the top of the lantern high while the young woman (right) shakes it open from below; pink-orange horizon behind.
SHOT 3 (00:04.0-00:06.3) — Medium close on hands: both women hold the bamboo ring at waist height; the wick in the centre catches and a small flame flares; the young woman's fingers twitch away from the heat, then grip the ring again.
SHOT 4 (00:06.3-00:07.8) — Inside the lantern looking up: wrinkled translucent white paper and crossing seams slowly fill out, glowing warm orange from below.
SHOT 5 (00:07.8-00:09.9) — Close-up of the young woman's face in three-quarter view, looking up and left at the lantern, pale blue dusk sky behind her, warm orange glow spilling in from the left edge of frame, hair lifting in the breeze.
SHOT 6 (00:09.9-00:11.6) — Medium-wide: the fully inflated lantern glows between the two women; a crosswind tilts it hard to one side.
SHOT 7 (00:11.6-00:14.3) — Medium, darker: the young woman hurriedly levels the tilted lantern by its ring, lips parted in concentration; the local woman's crimson sleeve at frame left.
SHOT 8 (00:14.3-00:16.0) — Extreme wide, deep blue night sky over the black field: one tiny distant lantern rises in the centre, a faint orange light on the far horizon.
SHOT 9 (00:16.0-00:17.7) — Inside the lantern again: the paper glows deep amber, fully taut.
SHOT 10 (00:17.7-00:19.5) — Medium: the local woman (left) smiles and adjusts the top of the glowing lantern; the young woman (right) holds the ring; the lantern lights both their faces.
SHOT 11 (00:19.5-00:22.2) — Extreme wide: from the far horizon, hundreds of tiny lanterns rise one by one into the dark blue sky above a glittering line of lights along the horizon.
SHOT 12 (00:22.2-00:25.0) — Close-up of the young woman looking up, the glowing lantern edge at frame left lighting her face orange, a slow soft smile.
SHOT 13 (00:25.0-00:27.0) — Close on her hands under the lantern's bottom ring: the lantern pushes upward against her fingertips, the flame visible inside.
SHOT 14 (00:27.0-00:31.5) — Medium close, side view: the young woman in front, the local woman smiling behind her at left. Her fingers open and the lantern slips smoothly up out of the top of frame; the orange light on her face fades; her hands stay raised and open as she gazes up.
SHOT 15 (00:31.5-00:33.8) — Straight-up low angle from below: the lantern's bottom ring, crossed wires and central flame, rising away against the deep blue sky (MUST SHOW: the round bamboo ring with a single bright flame in its centre, frame centre).
SHOT 16 (00:33.8-00:35.8) — Close-up of the young woman looking up, a hand blurred in the foreground, her face now lit only by soft night light.
SHOT 17 (00:35.8-00:37.8) — Wide from behind: the two women side by side, backs to camera, looking up at their single small lantern drifting high in the deep blue sky.
SHOT 18 (00:37.8-00:39.7) — Ground-level wide over dry grass: dozens of lanterns rise from the dark field all around; one large glowing lantern drifts past very close at frame left (MUST SHOW: lanterns rising from the nearby darkness, one brushing past the camera).
SHOT 19 (00:39.7-00:42.0) — Medium close: the young woman shrugs her shoulders and breaks into a wide laughing smile as lanterns brush past her cheeks, hair blowing.
SHOT 20 (00:42.0-00:43.8) — Looking up: the sky filled with glowing lanterns at different distances.
SHOT 21 (00:43.8-00:45.8) — Over-the-shoulder from behind the young woman: she rises on tiptoe and points one arm up at the lanterns against the blue twilight sky.
SHOT 22 (00:45.8-00:47.6) — Looking up: countless lanterns overlapping, impossible to tell which is hers.
SHOT 23 (00:47.6-00:49.9) — Close-up of the young woman: her pointing hand, blurred in the foreground, slowly lowers; a small soft smile.
SHOT 24 (00:49.9-00:51.8) — Wide from behind: the local woman wraps an arm around the young woman's shoulders; both look up at a sky full of thousands of lanterns above the dark field.
SHOT 25 (00:51.8-00:54.4) — Extreme close-up of the young woman's face in profile, eyes glistening, tiny lantern lights reflected in her eyes.
SHOT 26 (00:54.4-01:00.0) — From behind the two women's heads at the bottom of frame, the camera slowly tilts up until only the sky remains: thousands of lanterns filling the deep blue night. Hold to the end.

SOUND: no music, no dialogue. Soft wind across the grass, sneakers on dry ground, crinkling paper as the lantern unfolds, the scratch and soft whoosh of the wick catching, a gentle fluttering flame, paper rustling in the gust, a quiet breath of relief, the young woman's soft laugh in shot 19, distant faint murmurs of far-away people, then near silence and wind for the final sky.
prompt_short: Photorealistic handheld 16:9, dusk to night on a vast grassland. A young East Asian woman in a white linen shirt and an older local woman in a crimson shawl release a white paper sky lantern; thousands of lanterns rise around them. No music, emotional.
